### Thanksgiving in Worship
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/thanksgiving-in-worship
Passage: Esther 9:20-22
Points:
- God's rescue of the Jewish people from Haman's plotted destruction led to the establishment of the feast of Purim.
- Scripture supports setting aside special occasions outside regular weekly worship to thank God for specific mercies.
- While unredeemed humanity fails to honor God, believers should cultivate lives and services marked by joyful gratitude.
- Meditating on God's sovereign grace in Christ reminds Christians to thank Him continually in private and corporate prayer.
